title: Enterprise Architect
summary: Architect accountable for enterprise-wide principles, standards and cross-domain coherence.
body_markdown:
# Enterprise Architect

## Purpose

Set the frame within which all other architecture decisions are taken.

## Responsibilities

- Define principles and standards.
- Set thresholds for board-level decisions.
- Resolve cross-domain architecture conflicts.

## Decision Rights

Enterprise principles, standards, thresholds; chairs or advises the [[Architecture Board]].

## Inputs

Strategy; regulation; domain architectures.

## Outputs

Principles; standards; board decisions.

## Required Competencies

Enterprise architecture; governance; stakeholder management.

## Escalation Paths

Strategic conflicts → executive management.

## Related Governance Processes

- [[Decision Rights Model]]
- [[Architecture Change Process]]
